title: SSC CGL 2026 | BLITZ SERIES | MATHS MOCK TEST - 30

questions.q: An article is sold at a certain price with two successive discounts of 10% and 12%. If the selling price is given, what is the marked price?

In a storehouse, 8 boxes have an average weight. One box weighing a certain amount is replaced by a new box, and the average changes. Later, four more boxes are added. What is the weight of the new box that replaced the old one?
A right pyramid has an equilateral triangular base with side length 16√3 cm. The height of the pyramid is 15 cm. Find the total surface area.
In a right-angled triangle, if sin A = 28/53, find the value of 53 sin A - 45 tan A + 53 cos A.

Two circular pulleys with radii 14 cm and 6 cm are connected by a cross belt. The length of the straight belt between the contact points is 15 cm. What is the distance between the centers of the pulleys?

A 450√3 m cable links point P to the top of a tower at an angle of 30°. Another cable links point Q to the top of the tower at an angle of 60°. Points P and Q are on opposite sides of the tower. Find the distance PQ.

A luxury crown is made of gold, platinum, and copper. The ratio of their total costs is 6:5:1. The jeweler charges 10% manufacturing fee on the raw metal cost. If the cost of copper is a certain amount, what is the final selling price of the crown including the manufacturing fee?
Three varieties of tea costing ₹140, ₹160, and an unknown amount are mixed in the ratio 1:1:2. The mixture is sold at ₹228 per kg, earning a 20% profit. Find the cost price of the third variety.
Rahul is three times as fast as Karan, and Karan is twice as fast as Suresh. Rahul finishes a task in 45 days less than Suresh. How many days will all three take to finish the task together?
If x + 1/x = 4, find the value of x⁴ + 1/x⁴.

A traveler covers part of his journey by train at 72 km/hr in 3.5 hours, and the remaining distance by bus at a speed 25% less than the train's speed for 4.8 hours. What is the total distance traveled?
In a circle with center O, OM is perpendicular to chord PQ. Angle POQ is 90° and OM is 6 cm. Find the length of PQ.
If the radius of a sphere is increased by 12.5%, what is the approximate percentage change in its volume?
In a parallelogram ABCD, diagonals AC and BD intersect at right angles. If AC = 30 and BD = 16, find the length of the altitude from vertex A to side BC.
A trader marks an article 40% above its cost price and gives two successive discounts of 15% and 10%. What is the overall profit or loss percentage?
A and B start a business with capitals in the ratio 5:6. After 8 months, A withdraws his entire capital. If the total annual profit is ₹21, what is A's share?
The ratio of length to breadth of a rectangular field is 5:3. The cost of fencing it at ₹12 per meter is ₹1,152. What is the area of the field?
The daily sales of a shopkeeper for the first six days are ₹130, ₹140, ₹160, ₹190, ₹210, and ₹260. The average sale for seven days is ₹200. What is the sale on the seventh day?
In a circle of radius 13 cm, two parallel chords of lengths 22 cm and 18 cm are drawn on the same side of the center. Find the distance between the chords.
Two chords AB and CD intersect internally at point P. If AP = x, PB = x+6, CP = x-2, and PD = x+12, find the length of CD.
Find the area of the triangle formed by the coordinate axes and the line 3x + 4y = 24.
A is 12.5% more than B. B is 20% less than C. C is 37.5% more than D. D is 10% less than E. By what percentage is A more or less than E?
A certain sum of money doubles itself in 5 years at simple interest. If the rate of interest is 5% more, in how many years will it become triple?
The difference between compound interest and simple interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 12% per annum is ₹300. Find the sum.

Pipes A and B together can fill a tank in 12 minutes. B and C can fill it in 18 minutes, and C and A in 24 minutes. Pipe A is opened first, and after L minutes, pipes B and C are also opened. The remaining tank is filled in 7 minutes. Find the value of L.
